backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to impacted frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of several frontend files and assets.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining OKLCH color variables, dark-mode overrides, and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Simple HTML shell that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main UI for the Valentine experience, including personalization inputs, dodging 'No' button, success screen, and music controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login state, identity management, and an authentication context.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalAudio.ts: Hook for loading and controlling a local looping audio file with play, pause, volume, and mute state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder for query hooks since no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based romantic theme with warm palette, dark mode adjustments, and custom animations for hearts and UI effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom romantic color palette, typography, container settings, and animations using several plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, requirements, and image needs for building a romantic Valentine-themed single-page website.
